 1 | Animal Bonding | 1 animal | P | touch | Fm
 2 | Detect Bonding | 5'R | 1 min/lvl | 50' | P

17 | Blood Bond | 1 animal | 1 min/lvl | varies | U
19 | Spell Bond | 1 animal | varies | varies | U
20 | Cure Bond | 1 animal | P | touch | U

30 | Heal Bond True | 1 animal | P | touch | U
50 | Bond Extension True | all bonds | 1 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell allows the caster to make a pact of friendship and mutual aid with
one animal. The animal will kill and even sacrifice its own life willingly to
fulfill its end of the pact. If either party is ever killed, the surviving
member will be at -30 to all actions for one week, -20 to all actions for one
week, and then at -10 to all actions for one week until the shock wears off.
In addition to the friendship pact, the caster and the bonded animal can
mentally communicate with each other within the bond range (normally 5' per
level of the caster). Mentalism-based casters need not actually “speak” their
communciation aloud, but non-Mentalism casters and the animals will find it
necessary to speak (making whatever sounds the animal normally makes; the
caster will understand the croaks, barks, or whatever as if they were speech).
This spell does not grant either the caster or the animal the ability to
communicate with other members of their partner’s species. A caster may have
up to one bonded animal per every five levels (round up), but each such
bonding requires a separate casting of this spell. This spell does not provide
the caster with an animal, and takes one hour to complete.
@@ 2
Detects if any animal in the area of effect is currently bonded. Caster may
concentrate on a different 5'R each round.
@@ 3
Allows a bonded animal to go without food and water for one day without taking
damage from lack of “real” nutrition.
@@ 4
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
10' per level.
@@ 5
Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his
bonded animals: d10 hits per level of the caster, a bleeding wound that is
bleeding no more than 1 hit for every five full levels of caster (i.e., a
sixth level caster could stop a 1 per round bleeding wound; while a tenth
level caster could stop a 2 per round bleeding wound), or mild frostbite or
burns (one area per level of the caster). For the purpose of this spell, an
area of moderate frostbite or burn damage counts as two areas of mild damage,
and an area of severe frostbite or burn damage counts as three areas of mild
damage.
@@ 6
For the duration of this spell, caster can perceive the world through any or
all of the senses of any one of his bonded animals. The caster is limited in
perception by the limitations of the animal’s senses (so if the animal has no
color vision, the caster will not perceive color through the animal’s eyes).
The caster’s understanding of the available sensory data is further limited to
the perceptive faculties that he himself possesses (i.e., if the caster is
borrowing the sonar sense of a bat and does not possess sonar himself,
gibberish is received).
@@ 7
Caster can call (summon) any one of his bonded animals which will then try and
come to him. The range of this call is ten times the caster’s current bond
range.
@@ 8
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
15' per level.
@@ 9
For the duration of this spell, the fact that the target animal is bonded to
the caster is concealed from magical detection.
@@ 10
Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his
bonded animals (recovery time given in parentheses): one damaged muscle (1
hour), one damaged tendon (1 hour), one sprain (1 hour), any cartilage damage
(1 hour), any one broken bone (1 day), or any one shattered bone or joint (1
week). This spell can only repair an injury (it cannot replace a body part).
@@ 11
The caster can choose to release any one of his bonded animals from the
Bonding. The bonded animal may resist this spell. If released, the bonded
animal may remain friendly to the caster but may not remain long in his
presence (depending on the circumstances and its treatment during the bonded
period).
@@ 12
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
20' per level.
@@ 13
Gives the direction and distance to any one of the caster’s bonded animals.
@@ 15
Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his
bonded animals (with the recovery time given in parentheses): one damaged
nerve (1 day), one area of paralysis (1 day), minor organ damage (such as to a
sensory organ; 1 day), or major organ damage (1 week). This spell can only
repair damage (it cannot replace a body part).
@@ 16
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
25' per level.
@@ 17
For the duration of this spell, the caster and one of his bonded animals may
interchange energy at a rate of up to one concussion hit per level of the
caster or two exhaustion points per level of the caster (per round). This
spell will not allow either party to gain more concussion hits or exhaustion
points than their normal maximum.
@@ 19
The next spell with a fixed duration (i.e., not instant or concentration) to
affect the caster will affect one of his bonded animals. The duration of the
spell will be halved to reflect the sharing of magical energies. Thus, an
Invisibility spell will last (at most) 12 hours. The bonded animal is subject
to all the normal limitations on spells.
@@ 20
Using this spell, the caster can cure the following on any one of his bonded
animals: one disease, one poison, or one mental illness. Any damage already
sustained as a result of the disease, poison, or illness remains.
@@ 25
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
50' per level.
@@ 30
Using this spell, the caster can heal any injury on any one of his bonded
animals, including regeneration of body parts. The recovery time will vary
(d100 hours) depending on the nature of the injury (GM’s discretion). If the
injury is such that it would prove fatal to the bonded animal if not
immediately healed, the bonded animal will remain unconsious for the duration
of the recovery time (but will be healed of the damage at the end of the
recovery time).
@@ 50
For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to
100' per level.
